description: Baseline of prose-dispatch patterns under src/compass_backend/{execution,catalog,orchestration,planning,rendering}. Generated 2026-05-18 for the Bucket A scrub-brittle Wave 2 plan; extended to planning/+rendering/ scope. Every entry is a known multi-word phrase set or regex over user prose (or its semantic equivalent). New patterns not in this baseline fail the test_no_prose_dispatch.py guard; existing patterns are documented by role per the 'No prose-dispatch below the planner' section in CLAUDE.md.

roles.deletable: Slated for removal (see the 'No prose dispatch below the planning boundary' guardrail in src/compass_backend/AGENTS.md). Active routing/rewriting of typed plan based on user prose. New 'deletable' patterns should not pass review.
roles.canonicalization: Maps multiple typed-field labels (planner-emitted MetricSpec.name, SortStepSpec.field) onto a canonical key like 'enrollment' or 'frpl_pct'. Tracked for eventual migration into compass.catalog_aliases; doctrine-grandfathered today.
roles.validator-data-filter: Filters cell/answer values by content (e.g., excluding 'n/a', 'not addressed' from numeric answer parsing). Doctrine-correct because it filters DATA shape, not user prose routing.
roles.false-positive: Scanner match that is not actually a prose-dispatch pattern (display label, dict key tuple, output-rendering text assembly). Excluded from the rule by explicit baseline entry.
roles.typed-referent-resolver: Infers or maps typed prior-context fields from user prose (e.g., temporal context, profile fields) without routing, rewriting, or substituting typed-plan fields. The exemplar is planner._normalize_plan_sort_with_context. Doctrine-correct per CLAUDE.md 'No prose-dispatch below the planner' (the allowed third role). Added during scope extension to planning/+rendering/ for taxonomy completeness; no current entries use this role after PR #631 deleted the temporal-phrase regexes, but the role stays in the taxonomy for future use.
roles.prompt-context-selection: Matches user prose to select which optional planner-instruction snippets or prompt-assembly metadata (e.g., thinking-effort budget) to inject into the LLM's prompt context. Does not route, rewrite typed fields, add/subtract candidates, or substitute for planner work — the LLM is free to use or ignore the injected context. Distinct from validator (adds a check), candidate-broadener (adds a search term), and typed-referent-resolver (populates a typed field). Exemplars: planning.instruction_snippets.PlannerInstructionSnippet.trigger_phrases; planning.thinking._*_MARKERS.

match_key: (file, name) for named constants; (file, first_sample) for inline (anonymous) tuples/sets

entries.name: _LIST_THOSE_N_REFERENTS
entries.tracked_in: _LIST_THOSE_N_REFERENTS added 2026-05-28 (PR for #1011/#937) — strong list-those-N referents (`the N districts`, `those N`, `those N districts`) that fire the delta-intent detector on their own when prior context exists. Same prompt-context-selection role as _REFERENT_PATTERNS and _REPLACEMENT_MARKERS — gates the DELTA-INTENT CONSTRAINT in the planner system prompt; never routes or rewrites typed fields. Scope guarded by #1009.

entries.name: _NAME_LIST_ANAPHORA
entries.tracked_in: _NAME_LIST_ANAPHORA added 2026-06-19 (#1665) — the prior-result anaphora (the pure pronouns 'them'/'all of them' and the qualifier-guarded 'the districts'; 'those' is deliberately excluded as a determiner that can introduce a fresh selection) that pair with a name/list verb (_NAME_LIST_VERBS) to fire the delta-intent detector on a digit-free 'name them' follow-up after a count. Same prompt-context-selection role as _LIST_THOSE_N_REFERENTS / _REFERENT_PATTERNS — gates the typed inherit_selection_from='prior_result_rows' constraint so the prior count's state-qualified result rows are enumerated (no Portland ME/OR collision); never routes or rewrites typed fields below the planner. Gated on verb AND anaphora so a first-turn 'name 5 districts with sick leave' stays inert. Scope guarded by #1009.

Inline re.compile() for the 'all of them' name-list anaphora (#1665) — paired with the _NAME_LIST_ANAPHORA phrase_set entry of the same shape. Fires the digit-free 'name them' delta-intent only alongside a name/list verb; prompt-context-selection role, never routes or rewrites typed fields. Scope guarded by #1009.

entries.name: _REFERENT_PATTERNS
